raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "colorcet" %}
{% set version = "3.2.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 48d9a67e6e59dc5c0a965aa1b46fe5d59cdc95cc36a95949f29313f950ac59f7

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=30.3.0
    - setuptools_scm >=6
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
  imports:
    - colorcet
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://github.com/holoviz/colorcet
  license: CC-BY-4.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Collection of perceptually uniform colormaps
  description: |
    HoloViz Colorcet provides perceptually accurate, 256-color colormaps,
    including both continuous and categorical types, designed for use with
    tools like Bokeh, Matplotlib, HoloViews, and Datashader.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hoxbro
    - maximlt
    - droumis
    - jbednar
    - jsignell
